paite: Huchi in ka thuakzoh tak louh phet un Athen ah koumau kia nutsiat in om le ung hoih ka sa ua,
heading: Timothi Nasepna
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

paite: i unaupa uh Timothi ahihleh Khrist tanchinhoih lam a Pathian nasempa, nou hon hihkip ding leh na ginna lam ua nou hon khamuan ding in ka hon sawlta uhi.
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

paite: Hiai gimthuaknate ziak a kuamah alinlouhna ding un. Hiaite bang thuak ding a seh ka hi uh chih noumau ngei in na thei uhi.
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

paite: Na kiang ua ka om lai ua gimthuak ding ka hi uh chih ka hon hilhkholh bang ngei in atungta hi, huai na thei uhi.
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

paite: Hiai ziak in, ka thuakzoh tak louh nung in, khempa'n nou ahon khempuk kha dia, ka sepgimna uh athawn kha ding chi in na gindan uh ka na theihna ding in mi ka hon sawl ahi.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

paite: Himahleh Timothi, noumau a kipan a tua ka kiang uh ahong tun in, hon muh ka ut mahmah bang un nou leng hon muh ut mahmah in hehpih in na hon theigige uh chih leh na ginna uh leh na itna tanchin uh kipahhuaitak mai ahon puak hi.
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in unaute aw, ka mangbatna uleh gimthuakna tengteng uah na ginna ziak un na tungthu uah lungmuan in ka omta uhi.
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

paite: Toupa a na dinkip phot uleh tu'n tuh ka hingta uhi.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

paite: I Pathian ma ah na tung ua ka kipahna tengteng ziak un noumau lam thu ah Pathian kiang ah bangchibang in kipahthu ka gen thei zozen ding uam aw?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

paite: Na mel uh ka muhtheihna ding uleh na ginna lam ua na taksap awng uh ka hon huksak theihna ding un sun leh zan in nakpitak in ka thum uhi.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

paite: Huchi in Pathian, i Pa ngei leh Toupa Jesu'n leng, koute na kiang uah hon pitung hen.
heading: Thumna
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

paite: Huan noumau lam a itna ka hauh bang un, noumau khat-le-khat na ki-ittuah chiatna uleh mi tengteng na itna uh hon khangsak zelpa Toupa'n hon hausak semsem hen;
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

paite: huchi a i Toupa Jesu, amisiangthou tengteng toh ahong pai chiang a, i Pathian leh a Pa ma a na lungtangte uh sianthouna lam ah gensiatbei a om ding a nou ahon hihkip theihna ding in.
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
